messages:
maya: FYI I rolled a VPC egress tighten in eu-west-1 earlier and we're seeing ~15% of GPU nodes fail keystore handshakes during provisioning. Logs show repeated Decrypt failures and timeout spikes.

dan: Is that the rule change from last night? I'm seeing `kms:AccessDenied` and `net/http: timeout` intermixed in the same window. snippet: ```2024-05-03T09:12:01Z keystore-proxy ERR decrypt failed: AccessDenied``` 

liam: Oncall here — GPU warm pool nodes stuck in `Provisioning`. Kube events show `FailedMount` of /etc/keystore and the keystore-proxy returning 401 for some requests.

maya: I temporarily opened egress from the affected privnet subnets to the keystore cluster to get warm pools healthy. We need a permanent approach: audit shows keystore-proxy IPs are ephemeral across AZs. Options: PrivateLink, stable NAT with elastic IPs, or tag-based route to a set of ENIs. Tradeoffs: PrivateLink -> compliance + stable, but infra work + cost; NAT -> predictable quick fix but recurring cost.

sophia: PrivateLink aligns with compliance, but procurement + infra lead time is nontrivial. NAT GW is faster but adds ~£400-£800/month for eu-west per region; could be material given multiple regions. ENI-based routing might be middle ground but adds ops complexity.

dan: Short-term proposal: keep temp egress allow, add an IAM condition limiting keystore usage to the affected privnet CIDRs, and create a route/tagging plan for authoritative egress. Also update audit logs to include `kms:Decrypt` callerIdentity so we can trace failed calls. @oncall-bot please open an incident.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-893 - keystore-egress-block-eu - priority: P2 - assignee: maya - link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2024-893

maya: Thanks — plan I'll execute: 1) keep temp allow until midnight UTC, 2) push IAM condition PR restricting key usage to privnet CIDRs, 3) start PrivateLink PoC ticket (RFC + cost estimate). I'll also document rollback steps.

liam: Sounds good. Can we also add an alert for `DecryptErrorRate > 0.5%` and `gpu_pool_unhealthy_nodes > 3`? Make the alert include cost delta if NAT is used so we can compare.

sophia: :thumbsup: Agree. Please include cost metric in the alert runbook and tag the incident with `cost-impact` and `compliance` so finance and security get notified.

maya: Will do. I'll create the PRs and the PoC ticket, ping when ready for review.
